Bill.BriefDescription: Ordering the caseload forecast council to publish sentencing information concerning racial disproportionality.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sentencing information concerning racialdisproportionality; and amending RCW 43.88C.040.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.88C.040 and 2011 1st sp.s. c 40 s 28 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The caseload forecast council shall develop and maintain acomputerized adult and juvenile sentencing information systemconsisting of offender, offense, history, and sentence informationentered from the judgment and sentence forms for all adult felons. (2) As part of its duties in maintaining the sentencing informationsystem, the caseload forecast council shall: (a) On an annual basis, publish a statistical summary of adultfelony sentencing and juvenile dispositions; (b) On an annual basis, publish a summary of racialdisproportionality in adult felony sentencing and juveniledispositions; (c) Publish and maintain an adult felony sentencing manual; and (((c))) (d) Publish and maintain a juvenile sentencing manual. p. 1 SB 6257 (3) The sentencing manuals are intended only as a guide to assistpractitioners in determining appropriate sentencing ranges. Themanuals are not a substitute for the actual statutes, which list thesentencing ranges, or for any other information contained within thischapter. The caseload forecast council is not liable for errors oromissions in the manual, for sentences that may be inappropriatelycalculated as a result of a practitioner's or court's reliance on themanual, or for any other written or verbal information provided by thecaseload forecast council or its staff related to adult or juvenilesentencing. (4) In publishing materials required by this section, the caseloadforecast council shall make the materials available on its web site.The caseload forecast council may charge a reasonable cost forproducing and distributing hard copies of any materials.
